note: 安全合规架构评审十段中英草稿，呈现权限、隐私、证据与可用性的实际取舍；风险接受有责任人和到期日，未配音，无虚构时间轴。

series.title: 安全合规评审：边界、审计与限期风险接受
series.premise: 客服数据平台准备合规评审，现有角色分组与跨租户访问证据不足，旧系统管理员审批可用性是争议点。
series.outcome: 发现导出角色可继承管理权限，选择短期隔离遗留入口、实名限时双人审批及租户级数据边界，长期拆分授权服务；采用脱敏审计与受限关联证据，明确采集缺口。风险负责人只接受十四天有限遗留风险，不豁免法定义务，设置到期禁用及提前退出条件。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 未来评审候选，不算实际出现；本文件旧表达只使用既有库、S03–S07或本文件此前。

dialogues.title: 先定义要证明什么
dialogues.premise: 客服数据平台评审开始，尚未决定架构和风险接受。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出合规目标如何转成可检查的权限和证据要求。

lines.en: Our control objective is accountable data access. I'll take point on this review.
lines.zh: 控制目标是可追责的数据访问，这次评审我来协调。

lines.en: Define accountable in testable terms. Who can access which tenant, and why?
lines.zh: 把可追责转成可测条件，谁能访问哪个租户，为什么？

lines.en: Just to confirm, authorization and evidence both matter, right? A role name isn't enough.
lines.zh: 确认一下，授权和证据都重要，对吧？角色名称不够。

lines.en: Neither is an audit badge. We need actual controls and recovery behavior.
lines.zh: 审计标签也不够，需要实际控制和恢复行为。

lines.en: Maybe current groups already cover most access. I'll bring effective policy results.
lines.zh: 当前分组可能覆盖大部分访问，我拿实际策略结果。

lines.en: What's the ETA for those results? Each action item needs evidence, not reassurance.
lines.zh: 结果预计多久？每项待办需要证据而非保证。

lines.en: Privacy and legal obligations need separate confirmation. This meeting can't waive them.
lines.zh: 隐私和法律义务需要单独确认，本会议不能豁免。

lines.en: A new platform purchase? Let's park that. First examine current trust boundaries.
lines.zh: 购买新平台？先放一边，先检查现有信任边界。

lines.en: Include administrative recovery access. Restrictions must not make incident response impossible.
lines.zh: 包括管理恢复访问，限制不能让事件响应无法执行。

lines.en: Okay, I'll list support and recovery workflows. Their needs aren't identical.
lines.zh: 好，我列出客服和恢复流程，它们需求不一样。

dialogues.title: 租户标记不是强制授权
dialogues.premise: 现有角色清单提交，客服请求含租户标签，但服务端强制检查待核实。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分界面选择、请求标签和服务端授权边界。

lines.en: The authorization boundary sits in the export service. Tenant labels reach it from support.
lines.zh: 授权边界位于导出服务，客服将租户标签传给它。

lines.en: Does the service verify tenant entitlement? A supplied label isn't an authorization decision.
lines.zh: 服务会验证租户授权吗？传入标签不是授权决定。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis was server enforcement. Actually, this legacy path checks group membership only.
lines.zh: 原假设是服务端强制检查，实际上旧路径只检查组成员身份。

lines.en: Just to confirm, that's our blast radius for review, right? The legacy export path.
lines.zh: 确认一下，旧导出路径是评审影响范围，对吧？

lines.en: It's the confirmed gap. Check other routes before treating it as the only one.
lines.zh: 这是确认的缺口，检查其他路径后再判断是否唯一。

lines.en: I'm on it. Managed configuration lists two routes. One uses tenant-level checks already.
lines.zh: 我来做。受管配置列出两条路径，一条已用租户级检查。

lines.en: Compare effective behavior, including exports and retries. Don't infer controls from configuration names.
lines.zh: 对比实际行为，包括导出和重试，别从配置名称推断控制。

lines.en: Maybe the shared export group is too broad. I'll bring its inherited grants.
lines.zh: 共享导出组可能过宽，我拿继承授权记录。

lines.en: Good. Preserve current policy evidence before changes. We need a defensible baseline.
lines.zh: 好，修改前保存当前策略证据，需要可证明的基线。

lines.en: Okay, isolate the finding in our notes. No claim of cross-tenant access yet.
lines.zh: 好，记录中单独列出发现，尚不宣称已经发生跨租户访问。

dialogues.title: 继承授权跨过管理边界
dialogues.premise: 旧导出路径缺少租户检查，审查共享组继承的管理授权。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出潜在提权与已发生事件的区别。

lines.en: Inherited grants create privilege escalation risk. Export users can obtain an administrative role.
lines.zh: 继承授权造成提权风险，导出用户可以获得管理角色。

lines.en: I thought roles were separated. The inherited trust policy changes that conclusion.
lines.zh: 我以为角色隔离了，继承信任策略改变了结论。

lines.en: Separate potential permission from observed use. Has anyone reviewed activation records?
lines.zh: 把潜在权限和实际使用分开，有人检查启用记录了吗？

lines.en: Just to confirm, no confirmed abuse, right? That doesn't remove the permission risk.
lines.zh: 确认一下，未确认滥用，对吧？但这不会消除权限风险。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is legacy recovery access. Maybe support inherited it by mistake.
lines.zh: 当前假设是旧恢复访问，客服可能误继承了它。

lines.en: We can't rule that out yet. Missing activation logs also limit historical conclusions.
lines.zh: 目前不能排除，缺少启用日志也限制历史判断。

lines.en: I'm on it for owner confirmation. Recovery can use a separately approved identity.
lines.zh: 我来找负责人确认，恢复可以用独立批准身份。

lines.en: Verify that identity works before removing grants. Otherwise we create a recovery outage.
lines.zh: 撤权前验证那个身份工作，否则造成恢复中断。

lines.en: Okay, use the escalation path for suspected misuse. Architecture review won't replace incident handling.
lines.zh: 好，怀疑滥用就走升级路径，架构评审不能替代事件处理。

lines.en: I'll gather sanctioned recovery scenarios. No production attack demonstration is needed here.
lines.zh: 我整理批准的恢复场景，这里不需要生产攻击演示。

dialogues.title: 完整日志也要控制敏感内容
dialogues.premise: 发现继承管理风险及历史日志缺口，需设计可信且受限的审计留存。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解完整性、防篡改和隐私最小化不是同一件事。

lines.en: Evidence integrity needs protected storage and trusted timestamps. Raw payload logging isn't required.
lines.zh: 证据可信性需要受保护存储和可信时间戳，不必记录原始载荷。

lines.en: I'm on it for event fields. Identity, purpose, tenant, decision, and reference should suffice.
lines.zh: 我整理事件字段，身份、目的、租户、决定和引用应该足够。

lines.en: Also monitor delivery failures and gaps. Protected storage can't fix missing events.
lines.zh: 也监控投递失败和空档，受保护存储修不好缺失事件。

lines.en: Just to confirm, administrators can't delete their own records, right? Separate storage ownership.
lines.zh: 确认一下，管理员不能删除自己的记录，对吧？存储责任分开。

lines.en: Maybe immutable storage raises costs. The retention policy needs a justified period.
lines.zh: 不可变存储可能增加费用，保留策略需要有依据的期限。

lines.en: Yes, legal and privacy reviewers confirm it. Keep restricted correlation data separately.
lines.zh: 对，由法务和隐私评审人确认，受限关联数据单独保留。

lines.en: We'll keep an eye on collection lag. Sanitized dashboards show coverage without customer content.
lines.zh: 我们盯采集延迟，脱敏仪表盘展示覆盖而不含客户内容。

lines.en: Test restore and access auditing too. Retained evidence must remain usable by authorized reviewers.
lines.zh: 也测试恢复和访问审计，保留证据必须可供授权评审人使用。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for cost and coverage estimates? Roughly tomorrow afternoon?
lines.zh: 好，成本和覆盖预估何时完成？大约明天下午？

lines.en: That works for initial figures. I'll mark uncertain volume estimates rather than promise savings.
lines.zh: 初步数字可以，我标记不确定的量级预估，不承诺节省。

dialogues.title: 客服访问要有目的和期限
dialogues.premise: 审计字段与保护方向明确，讨论客服数据访问和应急管理访问分离。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出授权目的、租户范围与应急例外的边界。

lines.en: Purpose-limited access should follow a support case. Tenant scope and expiry accompany each grant.
lines.zh: 目的限定访问应关联客服案件，每项授权带租户范围和到期。

lines.en: A case number alone isn't permission. Validate ownership and requested data categories.
lines.zh: 案件编号本身不是权限，需要验证归属和所需数据类别。

lines.en: Managed configuration can enforce those checks. Normal support gets masked fields by default.
lines.zh: 受管配置可强制那些检查，普通客服默认看到遮蔽字段。

lines.en: Just to confirm, emergency access isn't blanket access, right? Name two approvers.
lines.zh: 确认一下，应急访问不是全权限，对吧？指定两个审批人。

lines.en: And backup approvers. Waiting for two unavailable people can extend an outage.
lines.zh: 也指定后备审批人，等两个不在的人可能延长故障。

lines.en: Maybe a time-limited recovery role works. We'll rehearse the approval path before switching.
lines.zh: 限时恢复角色可能可行，切换前演练审批路径。

lines.en: Record why unmasked data is necessary. Emergency access still needs retrospective review.
lines.zh: 记录为何需要未遮蔽数据，应急访问仍需事后评审。

lines.en: The smoke test must cover rejection too. Missing tenant approval should fail closed.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试也必须覆盖拒绝，缺少租户审批应拒绝访问。

lines.en: Set a rollback trigger for legitimate failures. Don't restore broad access without review.
lines.zh: 合法访问失败要设回退条件，不经评审别恢复广泛访问。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, separate support and recovery. Both paths need audited expiry.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，客服和恢复分开，两条路径都要审计到期。

dialogues.title: 快隔离与长期重建的取舍
dialogues.premise: 访问控制目标明确，比较立即拆分授权服务和短期隔离遗留入口。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出上线风险、审计成本和残余权限风险如何比较。

lines.en: The control trade-off is speed versus completeness. Which option reduces immediate risk safely?
lines.zh: 控制取舍是速度与完整性，哪个方案能安全降低眼前风险？

lines.en: Full separation takes weeks and changes recovery. Rushing it could create service outages.
lines.zh: 全面隔离需要数周并改变恢复流程，仓促实施可能导致中断。

lines.en: A temporary workaround isolates the legacy entry. Named approvals can buy us time.
lines.zh: 临时缓解隔离旧入口，实名审批能争取时间。

lines.en: Just to confirm, this doesn't fix inherited trust, right? That risk remains underneath.
lines.zh: 确认一下，这没修好继承信任，对吧？底层风险仍在。

lines.en: Correct. Restricted reachability is weaker than removing excess authority. Say that explicitly.
lines.zh: 对，限制可达性弱于移除过宽授权，要明确说明。

lines.en: Maybe choose containment now, separation next. A staged rollout needs independent gates.
lines.zh: 可能先控制再隔离，分阶段发布需要独立门槛。

lines.en: Compare staffing and logging costs too. Dual approval isn't free operationally.
lines.zh: 也比较人员和日志成本，双人审批有实际运维成本。

lines.en: A company-wide redesign? Let's park that. This proposal covers one legacy service boundary.
lines.zh: 全公司重设计？先放一边，这个提案覆盖一个旧服务边界。

lines.en: Acceptable only with a deadline and accountable owner. Compensating controls need evidence.
lines.zh: 必须有截止和责任人才可接受，补偿控制需要证据。

lines.en: Okay, I'll budget reviewer coverage. We need an after-hours backup, not just office availability.
lines.zh: 好，我预算评审人覆盖，需要非工作时间后备，而非只工作时间可用。

dialogues.title: 限期接受不是豁免义务
dialogues.premise: 选择先隔离旧入口，继承管理权限暂未消除，需风险负责人明确接受。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出风险接受范围、退出条件和不能接受的义务。

lines.en: Risk acceptance needs the accountable business owner. Our technical team can't sign for them.
lines.zh: 风险接受需要负责的业务负责人，技术团队不能代签。

lines.en: Nor can they waive legal obligations. Privacy counsel must confirm the permitted scope.
lines.zh: 他们也不能豁免法律义务，隐私法律顾问必须确认允许范围。

lines.en: The risk owner approves fourteen days. Only isolated legacy exports are included.
lines.zh: 风险负责人批准十四天，仅包括隔离的旧导出。

lines.en: Just to confirm, expiry disables that entry, right? No automatic renewal on delay.
lines.zh: 确认一下，到期禁用入口，对吧？延期不自动续期。

lines.en: Then test the alternate workflow now. An expiry outage shouldn't surprise support.
lines.zh: 那现在测试替代流程，到期中断不该让客服措手不及。

lines.en: Missing approvals or logs are a rollback trigger. Maybe immediate suspension is safer than fallback.
lines.zh: 缺审批或日志就触发暂停评审，立即暂停可能比回退更安全。

lines.en: Yes, define those as early-exit conditions. Any suspected misuse activates the escalation path.
lines.zh: 对，将其定义为提前退出条件，怀疑滥用就启动升级路径。

lines.en: I'll add an action item for backup coverage. Support accepts the limited temporary delay.
lines.zh: 我加上后备覆盖待办，客服接受有限临时延迟。

lines.en: Keep that impact visible in the risk record. Security gains have operational costs.
lines.zh: 在风险记录保留影响，安全收益也有运维成本。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, fourteen days maximum. Permanent separation still requires tested implementation.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，最长十四天，永久隔离仍需经测试实现。

dialogues.title: 审批记录缺少一个时间段
dialogues.premise: 风险期限已批准，审计抽查发现昨日审批事件有采集空档。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出证据缺口为何不能用仪表盘绿色掩盖。

lines.en: There's an evidence gap yesterday afternoon. Some approval events never reached protected storage.
lines.zh: 昨天下午有证据缺口，一些审批事件未进入受保护存储。

lines.en: The dashboard was green. Our working hypothesis was complete delivery, but that's wrong.
lines.zh: 仪表盘是绿色，原假设是完整投递，但那是错的。

lines.en: Does green mean storage availability only? That wouldn't measure event completeness.
lines.zh: 绿色是否只表示存储可用？那不能衡量事件完整性。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we can't claim continuous coverage, right? Pause acceptance of that evidence.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不能宣称连续覆盖，对吧？暂停接受那部分证据。

lines.en: Maybe source approval records can fill it. Their integrity needs verification before reuse.
lines.zh: 源审批记录可能补齐，复用前需要验证其可信性。

lines.en: Correct. Don't recreate missing approvals from memory. Unrecoverable gaps must stay explicitly marked.
lines.zh: 对，不要凭记忆重建审批，无法恢复的空档必须明确标记。

lines.en: I'm on it for source reconciliation. The retention policy still preserves yesterday's events.
lines.zh: 我来核对源记录，保留策略仍保存昨天事件。

lines.en: Add delivery counters and gap alarms. Storage protection doesn't prove pipeline completeness.
lines.zh: 加投递计数和空档告警，存储保护不证明链路完整。

lines.en: We can't rule that out as a control failure. Keep the legacy entry closed meanwhile.
lines.zh: 不能排除控制失效，旧入口暂时保持关闭。

lines.en: Okay, support uses the validated alternate path. I'll report the delay honestly.
lines.zh: 好，客服使用已验证替代路径，我如实报告延迟。

dialogues.title: 决策写明已证实和未证实
dialogues.premise: 源记录核对补齐部分事件，两条无法恢复；修正采集监控并验证替代流程。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解条件批准与全面合规声明的区别。

lines.en: The decision record lists two unrecovered events. It cannot claim complete historical coverage.
lines.zh: 决策记录列出两条无法恢复事件，不能宣称历史覆盖完整。

lines.en: Agreed. Updated delivery monitoring passes tests. Historical uncertainty remains a separate finding.
lines.zh: 同意，更新投递监控通过测试，历史不确定仍是单独发现。

lines.en: Managed configuration now enforces named approvals. The smoke test covers missing-event suspension too.
lines.zh: 受管配置现在强制实名审批，冒烟测试也覆盖事件缺失时暂停。

lines.en: Just to confirm, go/no-go depends on live evidence, right? Not the deadline alone.
lines.zh: 确认一下，继续或停止取决于实时证据，对吧？不只是截止。

lines.en: Yes, and alternate access passed recovery tests. Limited reopening still needs both approvers.
lines.zh: 对，替代访问通过恢复测试，有限重开仍需要两名审批人。

lines.en: Maybe reopen only reviewed cases today. The original fourteen-day expiry doesn't move.
lines.zh: 今天可能只重开已评审案件，原十四天到期不改变。

lines.en: The risk owner reconfirmed those conditions. That isn't a blanket compliance endorsement.
lines.zh: 风险负责人重确认条件，这不是全面合规背书。

lines.en: Just to recap, containment is active. Permanent trust-policy removal remains scheduled and tested separately.
lines.zh: 小结一下，控制已生效，永久移除信任策略仍单独安排和测试。

lines.en: Record dissent about approval delays too. Future reviews need the operational trade-offs.
lines.zh: 也记录对审批延迟的异议，未来评审需要运维取舍。

lines.en: I'll attach measured wait times. We can improve coverage without hiding customer impact.
lines.zh: 我附上实测等待时间，可以改善覆盖而不隐藏客户影响。

dialogues.title: 到期前验收长期隔离
dialogues.premise: 条件批准已记录，十四天风险窗口剩余时间内需完成长期隔离和审计验收。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出整改负责人、日期、证据及未完成时的处理。

lines.en: The remediation deadline is day fourteen. Who's picking this up for trust-policy removal?
lines.zh: 整改截止是第十四天，谁负责移除信任策略？

lines.en: I'll deliver the separated role by day ten. My action item includes inherited-grant rejection tests.
lines.zh: 我第十天前交付隔离角色，待办包括继承授权拒绝测试。

lines.en: I'll validate recovery by day eleven. Both regular and backup approvers must participate.
lines.zh: 我第十一天前验证恢复，常规和后备审批人都必须参与。

lines.en: Maybe support testing needs two days. I'll finish tenant-scope fixtures by day twelve.
lines.zh: 客服测试可能需要两天，我第十二天前完成租户范围样本。

lines.en: I'll review evidence on day thirteen. Unresolved findings won't disappear behind a signature.
lines.zh: 我第十三天评审证据，未解决发现不会因签字消失。

lines.en: Okay, our control objective stays unchanged. Missed deadlines mean the legacy entry closes, right?
lines.zh: 好，控制目标不变，错过截止就关闭旧入口，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. Keep the alternate path staffed. Closure must not force unsafe emergency access.
lines.zh: 对。保持替代路径人员覆盖，关闭不能迫使不安全应急访问。

lines.en: Just to recap, no automatic risk renewal. I'll track implementation and effective permissions daily.
lines.zh: 小结一下，不自动续期风险接受，我每天跟踪实现和实际权限。

lines.en: We'll close the loop with tested evidence. Historical gaps remain visible in the final report.
lines.zh: 用经测试证据完成反馈，历史空档仍在最终报告可见。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll confirm owners today. Compliance review continues after this architecture decision.
lines.zh: 同意，今天我确认负责人，这次架构决策后合规评审继续。
